visualCharacteristics.purpose: fixed set of different content pieces side by side (image | text, text | text, text | video, contact CTAs)
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile, equal-width columns from 900px; image columns sit first on mobile; a video column is a responsive 16:9 iframe filling the column width

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell per column; a cell holding only a picture is an image column; a cell holding only a link to fast.wistia.net / fast.wistia.com / youtube.com / youtu.be / player.vimeo.com becomes a lazy-loaded video embed; other cells are text (headings, paragraphs, lists, links). Style cta: each cell = lone link (rendered as button) + short paragraph

options.label: Call to action (button over text, centered)

reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed set of 2-3 different content pieces side by side that do not repeat as a list. Use Style cta for contact/action buttons over short text. For repeating look-alike items use cards-grid.
